text: Stepping from the quiet orderliness of a glass-walled meeting room into a vibrant exhibit space, I feel a sense of transition. The first scene is hushed and expectant, as if ideas are about to be debated or revealed, while the second is alive with color and innovation, inviting curiosity. I feel a quiet excitement, aware that knowledge is unfolding in both spaces, merely in different forms—one through conversation, the other through exploration. I am both an observer and a participant, wandering the boundary between reflection and discovery.
